acceptanceCriteria: A spec amendment to task-context-packet-v0 defines the RRF ordering (constant k, per-relation rank source, deterministic tie-break by slot order then path) as an experimental alternative to TCP corroboration, with requirement IDs.
A two-arm run (corroboration vs RRF) on the decision 0027 history-backed corpus reports gold rows at ranks 1-5, 6-10 and in the top 20 with the same samples in both arms.
A decision promotes RRF, keeps it opt-in, or kills it from that reading, recorded in BUILD-LOG; slot admission, caps and packet membership are unchanged in either arm.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 from a review of vectorize-io/hindsight (recall fuses parallel channels by reciprocal rank fusion). Rescoped 2026-09-24 by the owner after recording the current state: the task-context packet is slot assembly, not one ranked list. `compile` admits capped slots in evidence order (pair, mentioned, definition, reverse-import, reference, cochange, sibling, test, lexical fill; internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go:237-283), and `corroborate` (taskcontext.go:338-352, decision 0027) reorders by the count of other relations that would have admitted a path, +50 score each. Candidate: replace that count with reciprocal rank fusion over each relation's own candidate ranking (every row a generator produced, not only the admitted one), keeping slot admission, caps and the one evidence row per path unchanged. Evaluation corpus: the history-backed unseen-task runs decision 0027 used (benchmarks/results/cw-trial-unseen-corvint-v1-rank.json and the held-out development run). Out of scope: git recency as a fused channel. CORVINT_CONTEXT_RECENCY (TCP-V0-035..038, decision 0369) already reweights the lexical and cochange slots and cannot be measured on the frozen bench, which rebuilds snapshots as one commit; that follow-up waits on a history-preserving corpus.
title: retrieval: replace the corroboration count with reciprocal rank fusion over the packet's relation rankings, measured on the 0027 corpus
